newsitem.title: BRAZIL: JAPAN VOLLEYBALL PLAYER FALLS FROM WINDOW.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN VOLLEYBALL PLAYER FALLS FROM WINDOW.

text.p: A Japanese national volleyball team player was seriously injured on Thursday in a fall from a hotel window in the southern Brazilian city of Curitiba, a hotel spokeswoman said.
She said Hiroyuki Minami, 24, fell from a third floor window of the Grand Hotel Rayon and was taken to a hospital with serious injuries.
It was not clear whether it was an accident, she said.
Japan is due to play Brazil in two classifying matches for the men's world volleyball league at the weekend.
